svg.aria-label: the hooks: what Claude Code shows a session that edits where it shouldn't
svg.text: the hooks: what Claude Code shows a session that edits where it shouldn't

text.tspan: # a session that opens the repo meanwhile is told, and cannot edit the main checkout
[newcomer] $
claude-event session-start | integrator hook session-start
An integrator session ('integrator-csvtool', its SendMessage address) is running for this repo (~/work/csvtool): it
lands everyone's work on main. Before you edit anything in this repo, invoke the contributor skill: it gives you
your own worktree (`integrator join <topic>`), path claims and the submit flow. Edits to the main checkout are
refused while it runs (gitignored files are fine).
[newcomer] $
claude-event pre-edit reader.py | integrator hook pre-edit | jq .hookSpecificOutput
"hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
"permissionDecision": "deny"
"permissionDecisionReason": "The integrator ('integrator-csvtool') owns the main checkout ~/work/csvtool while it
runs, so nobody edits it directly (edits there block its landings). Work in your own worktree: invoke the
contributor skill, run `integrator join <topic> --session \"<your ListAgents name>\"`, move into the worktree it
prints (EnterWorktree), and make this edit there. Gitignored files here are fine."
# a claimed file is protected from the other sessions' Edit tool
[cli-delim] $
claude-event pre-edit reader.py | integrator hook pre-edit | jq -r
.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason
reader.py is claimed by 'csv-quotes' (reader.py: Keep commas inside quoted fields). Editing it too would make a
conflict. Ask the integrator ('integrator-csvtool', SendMessage) to arbitrate: it can order the work, split the
files, or `integrator grant cli-delim reader.py`. Work on something else meanwhile.
# the contributors hear about it at their next edit, sync, and leave; the integrator tidies
[cli-delim] $
claude-event pre-edit cli.py | integrator hook pre-edit | jq -r .hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
integrator: From integrator: #3 landed on main (main is now 51cee944a, disjoint). It was rebased: run `integrator
sync` before you submit again.
